messages:
Priya: FinCorp POC ask: migrate ~120k users from Okta. Needs SCIM bulk + ongoing delta, SAML primary, ~40 domains verified, delegated admin roles, RBAC mirroring Okta groups. Any immediate blockers? @Jordan can you sketch a short POC plan?

Jordan: Can do. Short notes: presigned S3 -> staged CSV import is our recommended bulk path. Hosted SCIM ~60 req/s sustained; Dedicated ~250 req/s (depends on commit). Batch size ~8k optimal. Prefer externalId as canonical key; fallback to email.

Camille: From their export: duplicate emails, some missing externalIds, ~90 groups with overlaps. Pre-clean needed: dedupe, mark disabled users, decide collision policy.

Jordan: SCIM mapping: groups -> Redwood roles (flat). No nested-group semantics in POC. Group PATCH max 2000 members per op; split large writes. Token rotation with 48h overlap. Delta sync uses since tokens; Dedicated median <20s.

Nora: Security: we'll provide SOC2 link, network diagram, and SSO questionnaire. SCIM endpoints TLS1.2+; mTLS available for Private installs. SAML requires signed assertions (SHA-256). Send security requests to security@redwood.com.

Alex: Pricing: we can offer hosted credits for a small trial, but full 120k import + low-latency deltas => recommend Dedicated reserved pool. I'll draft a quick quote for a 250 req/s pool and note commit options.

Camille: Short runbook to share: 1) pre-clean CSV (dedupe/externalId) 2) provision SCIM token + presigned S3 3) dry-run on 1k users + SAML smoke 4) staged imports (8k batches) 5) rotate tokens + enable domain lock 6) monitor audit logs 72h.

Jordan: Example minimal mapping CSV header to send: externalId,email,firstName,lastName,active,oktaGroups

Priya: Please drop the mapping template, security pack, and the Dedicated quote in this thread. I'll book the tech sync for Tue 10am PT.

DeployBot: queued import-helper job at 3420000100 by @Camille (no user-impact)

Priya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
